pc_reference.description: PES6 PC 1.00-layout PLAY runtime snapshot from a modified/protected installation with Kitserver; not proven pristine retail.

verification.method: Fresh MSVC compilation at trial and final source paths, followed by the normal full-function PC byte/reference comparator. Current source, object, compiler and verifier bindings were checked before export.
verification.object_hash_scope: Hashes identify inspected COFF objects; metadata can differ across paths or rebuilds.

limits: The PS2 image and original compiler were not available for native re-matching of this naming change.
This records PC-specific checks and is not a proof of cross-platform floating-point, ABI or whole-game equivalence.
Paths in this bundle are relative reproduction paths; no original image bytes, compiler binaries or absolute local paths are included.
The PS2 helper retains its original signature and expression order.
